name: H-E-B East Side Super Regional Grocery Warehouse - San Antonio TX

fieldNotes.location: Roster coordinates (29.365943, -98.360808) were ~5.5 km off (GEOMETRIC_CENTER of a city polygon over farmland). Web search resolved the facility to 2045 S Foster Rd, San Antonio TX 78222; the 1.6M sq ft warehouse sits at ~29.4063, -98.3670 along I-10 / Foster Rd on H-E-B's 871-acre East Side campus.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Dedicated truck entrance off Foster Rd, separate from the 'Partner/Visitor Entrance (No Trucks)' roundabout at the NE. A gatehouse building (red roof) with an attached smaller white-roofed structure sits beside the truck lanes; sliding perimeter gate visible on the fence line at z21. Clear controlled, fenced entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: The gatehouse complex at the truck entrance includes a small booth-footprint structure beside the lanes — a staffed gatehouse. guardShack true.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long landscaped truck approach road (~600 m) runs from the Foster Rd gatehouse to the warehouse; ample stacking depth for many trucks.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved truck staging lot with parked trailers immediately inside the gate, before the docks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Purpose-built cross-dock; roster/news cite ~200 dock doors. Dock banks with trailers backed in visible on the north and south building faces.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on two distinct building faces (north and south of the L-shaped structure) — consistent with separate shipping/receiving operations.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive drop yards with parked trailers along the warehouse faces and in the gate staging lot; well over 50.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide truck gate apron and long multi-lane approach road — clear room for a dedicated express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Site is on undeveloped land at the far East Side edge of San Antonio, surrounded by open fields and woods; functionally rural/edge-of-metro despite the city address.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property visible in current imagery.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Operational fenced footprint (warehouse + yards + gate); the full H-E-B campus parcel is 871 acres but most is undeveloped. Estimate from perimeter box.
